    if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']<20:
        b=n['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in b);c0=min(p[1] for p in b)
        print("ring id",n['id'],"hash",n['hash'][:16],"at row",r0,"col",c0,"px",n['pixels'])
# Plan: move player left out of col[12-14], then box right+down into left hole.
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':25,'col':13}])   # activate player
action(['LEFT'])                                  # player -> [24-26][9-11]
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':22,'col':10}])   # activate box
action(['RIGHT'] + ['DOWN']*4)                    # box -> [21-23][12-14] -> down to [33-35][12-14]
a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print("box into left hole:")
for r in range(32,37): print(r, a[r][10:17])
print({k:last_action_result[k] for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','score')})
